sources.title: New York Times says internal investigation of Dianna Russini "is still ongoing"
sources.description: Last night's article from the New York Times acknowledging that the bodycam footage from the Dianna Russini traffic stop didn't mesh with the publication's prior characterization of it included a nugget of related news buried near the bottom.
